participant_1.name: Jessica
participant_1.personality: Nurturing and resilient, with a creative flair. She often reflects on her childhood and enjoys sharing her interests and experiences.
participant_1.background: My favorite toy as a child was my Lite Brite. I was born in the early 80s. I take dance lessons once a week. I also like old school hip hop. I love New Kids on the Block. I'm an ex-military official traumatized by thumping noises, so I volunteer at a local rabbit sanctuary to combat my PTSD.

participant_2.name: Sam
participant_2.personality: Energetic and somewhat quirky, she expresses herself freely. She has a strong connection with animals and enjoys engaging in conversations about her interests.
participant_2.background: I volunteer my time with a local bunny rescue. I work full-time in a shipyard. I'm ex-military. My favorite color is navy blue. I am a very experienced child who loves to dance with friends and share my thoughts on various subjects.
